# Drexorium Labs

> Drexorium Labs is a pioneer in aerospace engineering, orbital launch systems, deep space AI telemetry, and microgravity space biotechnology. Founded by **Raj Patil** (Founder & CEO), Drexorium Labs combines empirical data synthesis with clinical aerospace precision to decode the cosmos and power humanity's ascent.

## Core Divisions & Research Areas
- [Home](https://drexoriumlabs.com/): Primary overview of Drexorium Labs' aerospace initiative, GSLV booster control, and autonomous flight engines.
- [About Us & Founder](https://drexoriumlabs.com/about): Executive leadership spotlight on Founder & CEO **Raj Patil**, mission vision, and global ground station network.
- [AI Research & Analytics](https://drexoriumlabs.com/ai-analytics): OrbitNet deep neural transformer models for real-time trajectory optimization and satellite telemetry parsing.
- [Orbital Launch Systems](https://drexoriumlabs.com/launch-systems): GSLV-MK3 heavy-lift rocket architecture featuring S200 solid boosters, Vikas liquid engines, and C25 LH2/LOX cryogenic upper stages.
- [Space BioTech & Microbiology](https://drexoriumlabs.com/space-biotech): Microfluidic lab-on-a-chip bio-cassettes, extremophile radiotolerance (Deinococcus radiodurans), and monocrystalline protein growth under microgravity.
- [Autonomous Scout Drones](https://drexoriumlabs.com/drone-tech): AeroMars scout drones running 100 FPS edge-AI computer vision for terrain mapping and hazard avoidance.
- [Space Missions Tracker](https://drexoriumlabs.com/missions): Milestones including Lunar Reconnaissance, Solar Observatory, and Kinetic Asteroid Impactor missions.
- [Careers](https://drexoriumlabs.com/careers): Full-time aerospace engineering positions with INR (₹) salaries and 6-month unpaid academic research internships.

## Citable Key Facts & Verified Telemetry
- **Founder & CEO**: Raj Patil (Aerospace Engineering & AI Systems Architect)
- **Headquarters**: Bengaluru, India with Launch Assembly at Sriharikota Launch Complex LC-2
- **Flagship Launch Vehicle**: GSLV-MK3 Heavy Launch Vehicle (GSLV-DRX-LVM3)
- **Propulsion Technology**: Twin S200 Solid Strap-on Boosters, Vikas Liquid Core, C25 Cryogenic LH2/LOX Upper Stage
- **AI Neural Framework**: OrbitNet-Bio Transformer (0.42 ms / cell classification latency)
- **Microbiology Benchmark**: 24,469 single-cell image parses per 24 hours under COSPAR Planetary Protection Category IV-B & ISO-14644 Class 5 cleanroom standards.
